label: Demo Customer Service
description: Tap an option to navigate. This menu is editable from /editor.

children.label: Update profile
children.text: Open Account > Profile and edit the fields you need, then click Save.

children.label: Change password
children.text: Account > Security > Change password. You will be signed out of other devices.

children.label: Delete account
children.text: Account > Settings > Delete account. This is irreversible and removes all your data within 30 days.

children.label: Download an invoice
children.text: Sign in, then Account > Billing > Invoices. Click the PDF icon next to the charge.

children.label: Update payment method
children.text: Account > Billing > Payment methods. Add a new card before removing the old one to avoid an interruption.

children.label: Refund request
children.text: Use the form at Account > Billing > Refund request. Most refunds settle in 5-7 business days.

children.label: Upgrade plan
children.text: Account > Subscription > Change plan. Upgrades take effect immediately.

children.label: Downgrade plan
children.text: Account > Subscription > Change plan. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current period.

children.label: Cancel subscription
children.text: Account > Subscription > Cancel. Access continues until the end of the period you have paid for.
